items.title: Jack Sheldon interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: I work sometimes with Jeff Goldblum, with a movie star band, with Peter Weller plays trumpet and Jeff Goldblum plays piano.

ctx.x: Yeah it always has been for me. I always work good and there’s a place called Steamers, a great club in Fullerton wherever that is, somewhere way out somewhere. I worked there. We’re going to record there in April. And I work at Chadney’s every Sunday night with Ross Tompkins, we do a duet. And then I work with the big band and work different

places with the quartet: Spagitinni’s and different clubs, the Catalinas in Hollywood, and I work sometimes with Jeff Goldblum, with a movie star band, with Peter Weller plays trumpet and Jeff Goldblum plays piano.
